# Phase 11 — UI Rewrite

## Vision
Migrate desktop UI to a maintainable component architecture aligned with orchestrated runtime state.

## Scope boundaries
- Componentized view model
- State-driven orchestration UI
- Accessibility and interaction quality
- No provider/routing core rewrites

## Dependencies on Phase 1
- Stable API surfaces (`jarvisApi` + `jarvisApiV2`)
- Runtime state snapshots
- Event bus stream/status events

## Security constraints
- CSP-compliant rendering
- No direct privileged API access from UI
- Strict preload bridge boundaries

## Rollout gates
- Feature parity checks with legacy UI
- Incremental tab/panel migration
- Regression and usability validation

## Success criteria
- Reduced UI coupling to backend internals
- Improved maintainability and testability
- No degradation of critical desktop flows

## Risks
- UI parity gaps during migration
- Increased temporary complexity from dual UI paths
- Performance regressions from rendering churn
